# KINECT

KINECT is client portal software for agencies, coaches and consultants: a
branded portal your clients actually open, with analytics and AI that
explains the work sitting right next to it.

## Persona sites

- https://agency.kinectnow.com/ - Client portal, campaign analytics and AI
  reporting for marketing and creative agencies.
- https://coach.kinectnow.com/ - Program delivery, check-ins and progress
  proof for fitness coaches and trainers.
- https://consultant.kinectnow.com/ - Engagements, deliverables and
  billable hours for consultants and advisors.

## Pricing

Flat monthly pricing, no per-seat fees and no per-client fees: Kinect $149,
Kinect Plus $399, Kinect Pro $799, and Kinect Enterprise $1,499 for firms
running more than one location. Kinect Enterprise includes 3 locations and
adds $250 per month per additional location. Every plan has unlimited clients
and a 30-day free trial with no card required.

## Status

Sign-up is open at https://app.kinectnow.com/signup. Every workspace starts a
30-day free trial on Kinect Plus with no card required. The waitlist this file
used to describe was retired when the signup handoff shipped.
